## 094d4f976dd5

**Reproduced exact-override contract defect (source SHA-256 `7d89f47fb8439b7e554fe54d10656f8a8b84a3ee36c4301e54cbb30bfe43e129`):** `AXES` advertises `panel_h=7..14` and `panel_w=3..6`, but generation narrows `draw_int` bounds by difficulty. A source-bound enumeration of all 48 axis-value/band trials rejects 27 declared exact values: 17 height cases and 10 width cases. For example, default `panel_h=7` raises `ValueError: draw_int('panel_h'): override 7 outside [8, 12]`; easy also rejects heights 10–14 and width 5; hard rejects heights 7–9/13–14 and widths 3/4/6.

The full trial table, errors, declared metadata, and source hash are in `checks/audit/094d4f976dd5/override-probe.json`. The attempted official override stage was externally interrupted before stage evidence and is retained honestly at `checks/audit/094d4f976dd5/override/result.json`; the direct public-API probe is the decisive reproduction.

The combined audit additionally found no task-local/frozen tests and no executable semantic contract (`checks/audit/094d4f976dd5/combined/result.json`). I made no changes to this target. Recommended repair: separate full exact override bounds from difficulty-weighted defaults, add `observe_overrides`, test every exact value in every band, and declare witnesses for copy-AFTER, demo-color, and no-clipping rivals described in the module comments.
